quests.instruction: Which word describes a very long, adventurous journey full of exciting experiences?
quests.question: Odyssey
quests.hint: Think about an epic, adventurous journey full of exciting twists, much longer than an ordinary trip.
quests.explanation: An odyssey is a very long, adventurous journey. An odyssey is often full of exciting experiences along the way!
quests.funFact: The word odyssey comes from a famous ancient story about an incredibly long sea journey home!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the system of buses, trains, and subways that move people around a city?
quests.question: Transit
quests.hint: Think about all the buses, trains, and subways working together to move people all around a busy city.
quests.explanation: Transit is the system of vehicles that move people around a city. Buses and trains are both part of public transit!
quests.funFact: A good transit system can help a whole city move around without needing so many individual cars!

quests.instruction: Which word describes being moved to a better, more comfortable seat than the one you paid for?
quests.question: Upgrade
quests.hint: Think about being surprised with a nicer, roomier seat than the one you originally booked for your flight.
quests.explanation: An upgrade is being moved to a better seat. Travelers are sometimes given a surprise upgrade on a flight!
quests.funFact: Getting a surprise upgrade to a roomier seat can make a long flight feel much more comfortable!

quests.instruction: Which working boat drags a large net through the water to catch lots of fish at once?
quests.question: Fishing Trawler
quests.hint: Think about a sturdy fishing boat dragging a big net behind it to scoop up many fish at once.
quests.explanation: A fishing trawler is a boat that drags a net to catch fish. Trawlers catch large amounts of fish at once!
quests.funFact: A fishing trawler's wide net can scoop up a huge school of fish in a single pass!

quests.instruction: Which traditional sailing ship has very tall masts covered in many large sails?
quests.question: Tall Ship
quests.hint: Think about a beautiful, traditional sailing ship with very tall masts, covered top to bottom in sails.
quests.explanation: A tall ship is a traditional sailing ship with tall masts. Tall ships are famous for their many large sails!
quests.funFact: Tall ships still sail today in special races and festivals, keeping old sailing traditions alive!

quests.instruction: Which special ship carries scientists and equipment to study the ocean?
quests.question: Research Vessel
quests.hint: Think about a special ship packed with scientific equipment, carrying scientists out to study the deep ocean.
quests.explanation: A research vessel is a ship for studying the ocean. Scientists use a research vessel to explore and learn about the sea!
quests.funFact: A research vessel often carries special equipment that can explore even the deepest parts of the ocean!

quests.instruction: Which super-fast train floats just above its track using powerful magnets instead of wheels?
quests.question: Maglev Train
quests.hint: Think about an incredibly fast train that floats just above the track, pushed along by powerful magnets.
quests.explanation: A maglev train floats above its track using magnets. Maglev trains can travel extremely fast with no wheels touching the track!
quests.funFact: Maglev trains can travel so smoothly that passengers barely feel any bumps at all!

quests.instruction: Which comfortable waiting area at an airport offers travelers a relaxing place before their flight?
quests.question: Airport Lounge
quests.hint: Think about a quiet, comfortable room at the airport with cozy chairs, where travelers relax before boarding.
quests.explanation: An airport lounge is a comfortable waiting area. Travelers relax in an airport lounge before their flight!
quests.funFact: An airport lounge often has comfy chairs and snacks to help make the wait before a flight more relaxing!

quests.instruction: Which wheeled cart helps travelers push their heavy suitcases through the airport?
quests.question: Baggage Cart
quests.hint: Think about the metal cart you push through the airport, stacked high with your heavy suitcases.
quests.explanation: A baggage cart is a wheeled cart for pushing suitcases. Travelers use a baggage cart to move heavy luggage!
quests.funFact: Pushing a baggage cart makes it much easier to carry several heavy suitcases at once!

quests.instruction: Which small label attaches to a suitcase to show the owner's name and destination?
quests.question: Luggage Tag
quests.hint: Think about the small paper or plastic label tied to a suitcase, showing exactly whose bag it is.
quests.explanation: A luggage tag is a small label on a suitcase. Luggage tags help identify a suitcase and its owner!
quests.funFact: A colorful luggage tag can also help a traveler spot their own suitcase quickly among many others!

quests.instruction: Which soft, curved pillow supports your neck for a comfortable nap during a long trip?
quests.question: Travel Pillow
quests.hint: Think about the soft, U-shaped pillow that wraps around your neck to help you nap comfortably on a flight.
quests.explanation: A travel pillow is a curved pillow supporting your neck. Travel pillows help make long trips more comfortable!
quests.funFact: A travel pillow's curved shape gently supports your head so it does not flop over while you nap!

quests.instruction: Which safety vest helps a person float if they fall into the water?
quests.question: Life Jacket
quests.hint: Think about the padded vest you wear on a boat that helps you float safely if you fall into the water.
quests.explanation: A life jacket is a safety vest that helps a person float. Everyone should wear a life jacket while boating!
quests.funFact: A life jacket is filled with light material that naturally floats, helping keep a person's head above water!

quests.instruction: Which small inflatable boat helps people stay safe if they must leave a bigger ship?
quests.question: Life Raft
quests.hint: Think about a small, bright inflatable boat that quickly pops open to help people stay safe on the water.
quests.explanation: A life raft is a small inflatable boat for safety. Life rafts help keep people safe if they must leave a ship!
quests.funFact: A life raft can inflate itself automatically within just a few seconds when it hits the water!

quests.instruction: Which lit-up sign on a plane tells passengers exactly when to buckle up?
quests.question: Seat Belt Sign
quests.hint: Think about the small lit-up symbol above your airplane seat that switches on to remind you to buckle up.
quests.explanation: A seat belt sign is a lit-up reminder to buckle up. The seat belt sign glows on during takeoff and landing!
quests.funFact: The seat belt sign often switches on again during a bumpy patch of air called turbulence!

quests.instruction: Which small folding table on an airplane seat lets you enjoy a snack or meal?
quests.question: Tray Table
quests.hint: Think about the small table that folds down from the seat in front of you on an airplane.
quests.explanation: A tray table is a small folding table on a plane. Passengers enjoy meals and snacks on their tray table!
quests.funFact: A tray table folds neatly away when it is not needed, saving space for the passenger behind you!

quests.instruction: Which unique code identifies a specific airplane trip on a schedule?
quests.question: Flight Number
quests.hint: Think about the special code, like a letter and some numbers, that identifies your exact flight on a board.
quests.explanation: A flight number is a unique code identifying a trip. Every scheduled flight has its own flight number!
quests.funFact: Checking your flight number helps you find your exact flight among dozens on a busy airport board!

quests.instruction: Which glowing lights guide a pilot safely along the runway, especially at night?
quests.question: Runway Lights
quests.hint: Think about the bright lights lining a runway, glowing to help a pilot land safely, even after dark.
quests.explanation: Runway lights are glowing lights that guide a pilot. Runway lights help planes land safely, especially at night!
quests.funFact: Runway lights use different colors to help a pilot know exactly where the runway begins and ends!

quests.instruction: Which sturdy bicycle has an extra-large front or back area for carrying goods?
quests.question: Cargo Bike
quests.hint: Think about a bicycle built with an extra-large basket or box in front, perfect for carrying deliveries.
quests.explanation: A cargo bike is a bicycle with extra space for carrying goods. Cargo bikes deliver packages in busy cities!
quests.funFact: A cargo bike is a clean, eco-friendly way to make deliveries without using any fuel at all!

quests.instruction: Which small scooter is powered by a battery instead of being pushed with your foot?
quests.question: Electric Scooter
quests.hint: Think about a scooter you stand on that zooms forward on its own, powered by a battery instead of your foot.
quests.explanation: An electric scooter is a scooter powered by a battery. Electric scooters zip forward without any pedaling or pushing!
quests.funFact: Many cities now offer rentable electric scooters that riders can pick up right from the sidewalk!

quests.instruction: Which type of bus uses both a regular engine and an electric battery to save fuel?
quests.question: Hybrid Bus
quests.hint: Think about a bus that quietly switches between a regular engine and a battery to help save fuel.
quests.explanation: A hybrid bus uses both an engine and a battery. Hybrid buses help save fuel and reduce pollution in cities!
quests.funFact: Many cities now use hybrid buses to help make public transportation cleaner and quieter!

quests.instruction: Which train travels through the night so passengers can sleep and wake up somewhere new?
quests.question: Night Train
quests.hint: Think about boarding a train in the evening and waking up the next morning in a brand new city.
quests.explanation: A night train travels through the dark hours. Passengers sleep aboard a night train and wake up somewhere new!
quests.funFact: Falling asleep on a night train and waking up in a new city feels like a little bit of magic!

quests.instruction: Which train travels quickly between two cities, skipping most of the smaller stops along the way?
quests.question: Express Train
quests.hint: Think about a fast train that zooms past small stations, stopping only at the biggest, most important ones.
quests.explanation: An express train skips most small stops. Express trains travel quickly between two major cities!
quests.funFact: Skipping smaller stops helps an express train reach its destination much faster than a regular train!

quests.instruction: Which train stops at every single station along its route, including the smallest ones?
quests.question: Local Train
quests.hint: Think about a train that stops at every small station along the way, not skipping a single one.
quests.explanation: A local train stops at every station along its route. Local trains take longer but reach every small stop!
quests.funFact: A local train is perfect for reaching a small town that a fast express train would skip right past!

quests.instruction: Which second flight continues a traveler's journey after a stop at another airport?
quests.question: Connecting Flight
quests.hint: Think about the second flight you board after a short stop, continuing your journey to your final destination.
quests.explanation: A connecting flight is a second flight continuing a trip. Travelers board a connecting flight after a layover!
quests.funFact: Airports post clear signs to help travelers find their connecting flight's gate quickly!

quests.instruction: Which numbered group tells passengers exactly when it is their turn to board the plane?
quests.question: Boarding Zone
quests.hint: Think about the numbered group printed on your boarding pass, telling you exactly when to line up.
quests.explanation: A boarding zone is a numbered group for boarding order. Passengers board a plane according to their boarding zone!
quests.funFact: Boarding by zone helps a whole plane fill up with passengers smoothly and without too much crowding!

quests.instruction: Which small bag is allowed to travel with you inside the airplane cabin instead of being checked?
quests.question: Carry-On Bag
quests.hint: Think about the small bag you keep with you the whole flight instead of checking it under the plane.
quests.explanation: A carry-on bag is a small bag kept in the cabin. Passengers keep a carry-on bag with them during the flight!
quests.funFact: Packing important items in a carry-on bag means you always have them close by during your trip!

quests.instruction: Which big screen at an airport or station lists every upcoming trip and its time?
quests.question: Departure Board
quests.hint: Think about the big screen at the airport listing every flight, its gate, and its exact departure time.
quests.explanation: A departure board lists upcoming trips and times. Travelers check the departure board to find their flight!
quests.funFact: A busy departure board can list dozens of flights leaving within just a single hour!

quests.instruction: Which big screen shows exactly when incoming flights or trains are expected to land or arrive?
quests.question: Arrival Board
quests.hint: Think about the big screen showing when your family's incoming flight is expected to land.
quests.explanation: An arrival board shows when incoming trips are expected. Families check the arrival board to time their pickup!
quests.funFact: An arrival board updates in real time if a flight happens to land a little early or late!

quests.instruction: Which spinning gate lets one passenger through at a time after they show a ticket?
quests.question: Turnstile
quests.hint: Think about the spinning metal gate at a subway station that lets you through after tapping your ticket.
quests.explanation: A turnstile is a spinning gate for one passenger at a time. Turnstiles check tickets at subway and train stations!
quests.funFact: A turnstile only spins forward after a valid ticket or card has been checked!

quests.instruction: Which machine lets travelers buy their own train or bus ticket without a person helping them?
quests.question: Ticket Machine
quests.hint: Think about the machine at a station where you press buttons and pay to print your own ticket.
quests.explanation: A ticket machine lets travelers buy tickets themselves. Ticket machines are found at train and bus stations!
quests.funFact: A ticket machine can print a ticket in just a few seconds after a traveler makes their choice!
